name: Barrier
body:
Design creation [force]; Level 5

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect wall whose area is up to one 10-ft. square/level
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A barrier creates an invisible wall of pure force, functioning as a wall of force spell except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you treat your caster level as +1 higher to determine the wall’s area.
